clauses.current_legal_basis: U.S. Code release point 119-121 (current through 2026-10-09) prints the order, as amended by EO 12347, 12388, 12474, 13118 sec. 10(7) and 13284 sec. 12, as a note to 19 U.S.C. 2511 with no ending statement, and notes to 19 U.S.C. 2512, 2514 and 2515 cite section 1-201 of the order for the delegation to the Trade Representative (jobs/current-law/output/USC_EO_NOTES.jsonl, heading Ex. Ord. No. 12260); 19 U.S.C. 2511 (jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/usc-t19-s2511.txt, current text) remains in the Code; a USTR notice in the Federal Register of Feb. 3, 2026 (Vol. 91, No. 22) sets thresholds effective January 1, 2026 in conformity with the provisions of Executive Order 12260 (jobs/selden-fr-citers/output/texts/fr-2026-02106.txt); no eCFR or OFR-catalog ending found through 2026-10-14.
clauses.reason: The clause applies the obligations of the Agreement on Government Procurement to the Annex agencies, assigns interpretation and thresholds to the Trade Representative (secs. 1-102, 1-104), requires consultation (1-103, 1-105) and delegates presidential functions under 19 U.S.C. 2511, 2512, 2514, 2515(c) and 2516 to the Trade Representative with a Secretary of Defense waiver (1-201, 1-202). The five later orders amended the preamble and Annex only, as later events; the clause continues amended. The 2026 USTR notice applies the order.

research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 12260 of December 31, 1980, 46 FR 1653, held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12260.txt; it implements the Agreement on Government Procurement under Title III of the Trade Agreements Act of 1979 (obligations apply to listed agencies in the Annex; Trade Representative interprets and sets the dollar equivalent; sec. 1-201 delegates the President's functions under 19 U.S.C. 2511, 2512, 2514, 2515(c) and 2516; sec. 1-202 Secretary of Defense waiver). Later instruments, all amendments: EO 12347 (Feb. 23, 1982) adds the Maritime Administration to the Annex; EO 12388 (Oct. 14, 1982; effective Aug. 24, 1982 under its sec. 6) renames an agency in the Annex; EO 12474 (Apr. 17, 1984) removes, renames and adds Annex items and cites 19 U.S.C. 2511 et seq.; EO 13118 sec. 10(7) (Mar. 31, 1999; effective Apr. 1, 1999 under its sec. 11) replaces an agency name in the Annex; EO 13284 sec. 12 (Jan. 23, 2003; effective Jan. 24, 2003 under its sec. 21) adds the Department of Homeland Security to the Annex. OFR catalog notes record each as an amendment; none says Revoked or Superseded. Searches of held texts for the number also find Federal Register notices from 1994 through 2026 citing the order; the 2016 and 2026 USTR notices apply it, and the 2026 notice says the thresholds are determined in conformity with the order. Bounded searches read for coverage: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121 USLM text and notes, citations of the order by number, edition current through 2026-10-09, laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts).
